purpose: MB_PATH (lazy chain), MB_AT_PATH (at_path<Path, T>) and seven arms of at_path, each one change against HEAD (bench/arms/MB_AT_PATH_<arm>), g++-16 and clang 23, twitter, floats and records. MB_PATH_LOCAL_DECODER and MB_PATH_HEAD_LIKELY are the lazy chain over the headers of the arm. MB_PATH_AA and MB_AT_PATH_AA are HEAD built a second time. ns per message, real_time.
rule: an arm differs from a reference when it lies outside both binaries of the reference (built twice) and the gap to the nearer one is above the A/A of the reference in that cell and above the floor of 2.65 percent
steal_rule: a round whose steal is above 0.1 percent of the CPU time is excluded from every median
order: each round runs every binary once, in an order from shuf
wait: the run started 150 s after the previous build or run ended; load 0.33 1.64 1.91 1/105 20327; podman ps: 0 running
flags: -std=c++23 -O2 -march=native -falign-functions=64 -falign-loops=64 -DNDEBUG -Werror, default PIE mode of the compiler of the image
